status: FINAL for sledpack@0.1.0 iteration I9 (after independent review research/sledpack_2026_10_21/review/report.json). Numbers from the 48-case FULLRUN_CASES_R4 ensemble, dev/results.json
evidence: numerical-uncalibrated simulation; NOT physically tested; G-MATURE closed, M-070 not_run. Any promo must label every frame as concept/simulation, never as real footage, and must not present untested behaviour as proven

name.zh: SledPack 无杆背包软翼风筝相机

coords: body frame: f forward along ski heading, l left, u up; metres; relative to the shared bodyPoints() pelvis point unless noted

pack.type: slim spine unit on a harness (or clipped to the rider's own pack/back protector): Ø60 mm sleeve along the spine + lumbar module; NO pole, NO boom

sleeve.runs: vertically along the spine, bottom end (mouth) at the sacrum, top ≈0.53 m above the pelvis point (below the pack top / shoulder blades)

mouth.funnel: orange Ø120 mm swivel funnel on a ±80° spring-centred ball gimbal
mouth.guard: design follow-up (not simulated): flip-down cover + roller fairlead against chairlift seats and backward falls

lumbarModule.contents: two-drum reel (main + depower line) with 2204-class motor and spring brake, 2S 18650 pack (120 g) in a heated pouch, MCU/IMU/GNSS/baro, tension/line-angle eyelet, weak link 38 N + cutter, dock charging contacts

pack.led: status LED on the left shoulder strap; one strap button = session arm / manual stow

kite.type: single-skin sled kite, two longitudinal carbon keel spars, no cross spar, bridle V to the apex, drogue tail
kite.fabric: Icarex-class 31 g/m² ripstop, hi-vis orange with white centre panel

tail.drogue: Ø0.12 m pink cone (render) / Ø0.25 m design, CdA ≈0.05 m²

pod.camera: 48 MP 4:3 gyro-EIS module (30 g, 3.2 W counted), 66° lens, looks down the line at the rider; lens 0.12 m below the line (keep the main line out of the onboard view; judged artefact share ≈0)
pod.cell: 1S 160 mAh, warmed then charged in the sleeve

kite.folded: pulled apex-first through the swivel funnel: the keels come together and the sail wraps round them, bundle Ø≈50 × 0.46 m

lines.main: 0.30 mm UHMWPE hi-vis pink, mouth → apex
lines.depower: 0.20 mm white, second drum → sail trailing edge (last 5 % of stroke flags the sail)
lines.twistRisk: main + depower + tail line from one mouth can twist: swivel at the apex and line separation at the eyelet needed (not simulated)

timing_s.tailwindEnvelope: no launch / early retrieve when the estimated along-course tailwind > 6 m/s (disclosed refusal)

phases.zh: 背着走/坐缆车：风筝收在脊柱套管里，背包先加热再给吊舱充电
phases.en: Walking/lift: kite inside the spine sleeve; the pack warms then charges the pod cell

phases.zh: 蹬出约 1 s：IMU+GNSS+气压判定起滑（缆车/上坡锁定），估计相对风 ≥5.5 m/s 才放；估计顺风 >6 m/s 时不放飞
phases.en: ≈1 s after push-off: IMU+GNSS+baro confirm the ride (lift/uphill lockout); launches only at ≥5.5 m/s estimated apparent wind; no launch above ≈6 m/s estimated tailwind

phases.zh: 气流把吊舱和折叠风筝从骶骨处的套管口拉出，先泄力低空拖出 3 m，再给力张开、爬升到约 55°，放到 6 m
phases.en: The airflow pulls the pod and folded kite out of the sacrum mouth, it streams flagged and low to 3 m, then is powered, opens and climbs to ≈55°, line out to 6 m

phases.zh: 背包的泄力线控拉力（约 13 N），卷轴只管线长和松线
phases.en: The pack's depower line holds ≈13 N; the reel only manages length and slack

phases.zh: 减速：全泄力，帆像旗一样塌下；趁人还在滑、风筝还在身后立即快速拉低（顺风停下时不让它飘过头顶），落低后拖回
phases.en: Slowing: full depower flags the sail; it is pulled down fast while the rider still slides and the kite is still behind (so a tailwind stop cannot carry it over the head), then towed in low

phases.zh: 最后 1.5 m 慢收，吊舱进入万向漏斗，翼杆并拢滑进套管，触点接通充电
phases.en: Last 1.5 m slow, the pod enters the swivel funnel, keels close and slide into the sleeve, contacts mate

doNotClaim: meets all 13 criteria (it fails avail, jitter, azRange (commandable 0°), headClear)
works in all winds (does not fly above ≈6 m/s tailwind; tailwind avail ≈22 %)
you can choose the viewing angle (it cannot be steered)
the line stays ≥1 m from the head (geometry forbids it without a pole; min 0.40 m)
KE passes with margin (14.43 vs 14.9 J; fails at kite mass +10 % and for 15–17 m/s riders)
